mapper.insert: insert into comment(film_id, score, comment, issuer_id, issuer_type, time, type) values (#{filmId}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{issuerId}, #{issuerType}, #{time}, #{type})
mapper.update: update comment set film_id = #{filmId}, score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, issuer_id = #{issuerId}, issuer_type = #{issuerType}, time = #{time}, type = #{type} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select comment.*, film.name as filmName, CASE WHEN comment.issuer_type = 'USER' THEN user.name WHEN comment.issuer_type = 'ADMIN' THEN admin.name ELSE null END as issuerName from comment left join film on comment.film_id = film.id left join user on comment.issuer_id = user.id AND comment.issuer_type = user.role left join admin on comment.issuer_id = admin.id AND comment.issuer_type = admin.role where comment.id = #{id}
